name: Deploy GitHub Pages site
description: A GitHub Action to deploy an artifact as a GitHub Pages site

timeout.description: Time in milliseconds after which to timeout and cancel the deployment (default: 10 minutes)

error_count.description: Maximum number of status report errors before cancelling a deployment (default: 10)

reporting_interval.description: Time in milliseconds between two deployment status report (default: 5 seconds)

artifact_name.description: Name of the artifact to deploy

preview.description: Is this attempting to deploy a pull request as a GitHub Pages preview site? (NOTE: This feature is only in alpha currently and is not available to the public!)
